title: River flood warning in York County
summary: Days of heavy rain push the Catawba River above flood stage near Rock Hill. NWS issues a Flood Warning. Shows the Warning level.

alerts.headline: FLOOD WARNING FOR THE CATAWBA RIVER NEAR ROCK HILL
alerts.description:
SIMULATED ALERT. ...The Flood Warning is in effect for the Catawba River near Rock Hill.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and is forecast to continue.
* WHERE...Catawba River near Rock Hill.
* WHEN...Until further notice.
* IMPACTS...At 15 feet, water covers low parts of River Park and nearby trails.
alerts.instruction: SIMULATED. Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
